# Aficion

> A constellation atlas of hobbies. 331 nodes across 22 clusters, joined
> by typed edges that say why two things sit together. Mark what you
> practise, set your dedication from Low to Hardcore, watch the gold
> paths join your nodes, and share the whole map as a link that never
> touches a server.

Notes for agents:

- Everything is client-side: no backend, no accounts, no analytics. A
  visitor's map lives in their browser (localStorage) and in the `#p=`
  fragment of a share link, which browsers never send to a server.
- The corpus is data, not code: `data/atlas.json` (clusters, tags),
  `data/clusters/*.json` (hobby nodes), `data/edges.json` (typed edges
  with why-connected notes), `data/inner/*.json` (drill-in subtrees),
  `data/builds.json` (curated builds in dependency order),
  `data/sheet.json` (character sheet domains and earned titles), and
  `data/examples.json` (loadable example maps).
- The feed of record for launches and changes across the fleet:
  https://dispatch.neorgon.com/
- Corrections to any fact in the corpus: use the Report a correction
  link in the site footer (it opens Balise with page context).

## Key surfaces

- The atlas: https://aficion.neorgon.com/ (pan, zoom, mark, drill in)
- Character sheet: the Sheet button folds a profile into a six-domain
  radar with earned titles
- Curated builds: the Builds button lists ordered stacks for ambitious
  cross-domain projects
- Compare: paste a friend's share link; their map is read in the tab
  and never saved or merged
